purpose: Third Trial multispectral treatment and growth comparison
day7_observed_policy: Observed NDVI and NDRE values are preserved.
day7_adjusted_policy: Only flagged possible bug-eaten cells receive separate adjusted Day 7 values.
imputation_method: Linear projection from up to the latest three valid prior observations. If fewer than two valid observations exist, the latest valid value is carried forward.
inside_outside_policy: Direct comparison is limited to Ideal and Moisture trays because Heat trays changed environment.
interpretation_warning: NDVI/NDRE are relative image-derived indices unless calibrated reflectance is available.
